generation: The same fixed historical population, not a new population per acquisition

column_roles.person_id: Unique invented unit ID; not a real person
column_roles.group: Teaching contact group A/B, not a protected attribute or causal factor
column_roles.online_frame: Fixed membership in the online contact frame
column_roles.need_weekend: Fixed latent binary need for the same specified weekend; simulation and post-plan audit input

acquisition_rules.register: Equal-probability invitations without replacement among all 4000
acquisition_rules.register_complete: Ideal full response; separate comparison, not default reality
acquisition_rules.web: Equal-probability invitations without replacement among online_frame=1 only

invitation_cost: Teaching units A=1/B=3 per invitation in every mechanism; excludes follow-up and response costs
audit_protocol: Choose and save all compared plans from frame.csv before acquisition; inspect simulator outcomes only for post-plan audit. Local file readability is not technical access prevention.
scope: Synthetic teaching exercise; no real survey observations, personal data, consent records or institutional effects
